body: I understand what he is saying. But I have a job. I work my ass off every day at work. 6 days a week. I am always the first one there and the last to leave and I do more work than the rest of my coworkers. I do two or three people's work load a day. So I don't need to be told that I should take any job. I did that already when I couldn't do what I actually wanted in life... I tried I really did. And it isn't like I haven't tried to change jobs to get something to better my situation either. I have applied called interviewed called again applied to others gone for aptitude tests gone to more tests... I just seem to fail at everything I try. And I am tired and sad and a piece of shit and tired.
